annotations.title: Find poses by level and situation

description: List poses from the reviewed YogaMag pose library that match a level, body area or type of pose, and that suit what the person avoids (the floor, kneeling, weight on the wrists), naming the easier version where the pose itself does not. Only poses with a reviewed profile are listed. Read a pose with get_glossary_term before describing it.

avoid.description: What the person cannot or does not want to do: floor = cannot get down to the floor, kneeling = cannot kneel, wrists = no weight on the wrists

limit.description: How many poses to return, default 10

name: find_poses
